title: Decision (one line of records/decisions.jsonl)
description: A decision as the member recorded it: the question as it was put, naming the proposals by ID, and the decider's reply in their own words. A decision is final only when the founder signs it at close-out (records/signatures.jsonl, written by scripts/fos_close.py). Until then it is provisional; if it is not signed it stays a proposal.

proposal_ids.description: The proposals decided. Empty for a decision that changes no structure (for example, a choice between two framings).

question.description: The question exactly as it was put, naming each proposal by ID: 'Do you adopt P-0004 (switch on the claim-discipline module)?'

framed_by.description: Who framed the question and its options.

decided_by.description: Role instance ID of the decider.

right.description: The decision right used, as named in org/config.json decision_rights.

words.description: The decider's reply, quoted exactly. Not a paraphrase, not a summary.

amendment.description: If verdict is amended: the change as amended.

founding.description: true on the decision the member puts to the founder as the founding (onboarding/START.md, step 8). It only tells the close-out which decision to show at its founding prompt: the label founds nothing. The organization is founded when the founder types FOUND at that prompt, and the close-out commits that signature on its own before any structure; the check and the witness read the founding from the history alone.

corrects.description: Optional. ID of an earlier decision record this one replaces because it was recorded wrongly. A change of mind is a new decision, not a correction. Whether the organization is founded never depends on it: only the founder's FOUND at a close-out founds it.
